title: Cover letter opening paragraph with fixed facts
prompt_text: Write the opening paragraph of a cover letter, at most 120 words, using only these facts and nothing else. The applicant has four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn. They built a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18 per cent over six months. They led a team of three. The role is Data Analyst at a mid-sized logistics company. The job advert asks for SQL and dashboard experience; the applicant has used SQL occasionally and has never built a dashboard. Do not invent any employer name, project name, dates or additional skills, and do not overstate the SQL experience.

content: I am writing to express my interest in the Data Analyst position at your mid-sized logistics company. With four years of experience utilizing pandas and scikit-learn, I have developed robust analytical solutions, including a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18 percent over six months. In this role, I led a team of three to deliver these results. While my background is deeply rooted in Python-based machine learning libraries, I acknowledge your requirement for SQL and dashboard expertise. I have used SQL occasionally and have not previously built dashboards. I am eager to apply my proven track record in model optimization and team leadership while expanding my technical toolkit to meet your specific needs effectively.
